diagnostics.message:
[final-gpt-6-luna-effort-high-run1]
The self-managed worker Auto Scaling group can begin launching nodes before the `aws-auth` ConfigMap is installed. The module explicitly gates managed node groups on this ConfigMap to avoid node registration races; this ASG needs the same ordering.

----------------------------------------

[final-gpt-6-luna-effort-high-run2]
The Auto Scaling group can launch worker instances before :resource.kubernetes_config_map.aws_auth maps their IAM role, creating a race in which the nodes cannot authenticate to the cluster.

----------------------------------------

[final-gpt-6-luna-effort-high-run3]
Worker instances can launch before the aws-auth ConfigMap maps their IAM roles, so `:resource.aws_autoscaling_group.workers` should wait for `:resource.kubernetes_config_map.aws_auth` to avoid nodes attempting to join before authentication is configured.

[final-gpt-6-luna-effort-high-run1]
The self-managed worker Auto Scaling group can launch instances before the worker-node IAM policy is attached, so instances may start without the permissions needed to join and operate in the cluster. Gate the ASG on this attachment, as the module does for managed node groups.

----------------------------------------

[final-gpt-6-luna-effort-high-run2]
The Auto Scaling group launches worker instances but does not wait for :resource.aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.workers_AmazonEKSWorkerNodePolicy; instances can start before their IAM role has the worker-node permissions required to join the cluster.

----------------------------------------

[final-gpt-6-luna-effort-high-run3]
The Auto Scaling group may launch workers before the required EKS worker-node policy is attached; `:resource.aws_autoscaling_group.workers` should depend on `:resource.aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.workers_AmazonEKSWorkerNodePolicy` so instances have the permissions needed to register and operate.

----------------------------------------
